segments.name: Fire safety equipment
products: Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and Fire Safety Apparel
segments.description: Sells fire safety equipment, foam systems, fire-resistant doors and protective apparel to municipalities, fire contractors, distributors and individuals.
segments.evidence: The Company views its current business as one reportable operating segment with operations in one geographic area, namely Malaysia.

revenueModel.text: Municipalities, fire contractors, distributors and individuals pay the company directly for fire safety products bought from it.
revenueModel.evidence: All products are sold directly to customers (e.g., municipalities, fire contractors, distributors and individuals).

changes.text: In 2025, after acquiring Fitters, the single segment changed from cancer medicine development to fire safety distribution.
changes.evidence: Prior to the acquisition of Fitters, the Company operated as a single segment engaged in the development of innovative cancer medicines based on cell cycle, transcriptional regulation and mitosis control biology.
